scope: Planning only; no game files or generated art changed

liveProductionIdentities.name: Jed
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep the gray hair, beard and work apron; broaden the head/face shapes, simplify the tools, and give him tired warmth instead of a stern concept-art stare.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Scrapper
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep hood and goggles; narrow, watchful eyes and a guarded half-smile. Distinct from the burly arena operator.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Doc
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep the exhausted male medic identity, messy hair and teal clinical clothing. Bold eye bags and one medical patch; reduce fine costume detail.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Foreman Boggs
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Preserve stout build, moustache and industrial yellow helmet; simplify armor and give him a managerial scowl.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Guard Hank
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Preserve blue uniform, cap and heavy-lidded boredom. Ordinary guard, not another boss.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Miner Bill
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Preserve miner helmet, moustache and weary friendliness; larger readable face, less painted texture.

liveProductionIdentities.name: The Warden
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Match the active Iron Warden’s enclosed brass/steel armor, cyan visor and command insignia. Do not base the portrait on the unrelated older exposed-face design.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Jax
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep older salt-and-pepper bartender identity, broad shoulders and loader claw. Larger expressive face; the claw is a secondary silhouette cue, not the subject.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Mika
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Bright vendor expression, orange bandanna, yellow apron and simple utensil already sit close to the intended family.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Museum Curator
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep swept silver hair, neat facial hair and violet high collar. Simplify the ornate costume into a futuristic museum official, with precise disapproval.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Hacked Lab Terminal
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep the readable screen/terminal portrait as an intentional system-image family. Do not turn every puzzle control into a new human face.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Director Mara Thorne
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep mature face, silver bob and tailored executive blue. Controlled, assessing expression and expensive restraint; soften rendering, not authority.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Maintenance Bot
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep the warm garden-bot shell, amber eye and leaf cue. It belongs to the Solarium only, not the archive or commissary.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Elara
liveProductionIdentities.direction: User-approved revision: human adult with warm brown skin, amber-brown eyes, strong brows and dark brown wavy hair loosely tied back. Mature attentive face with subtle tiredness. Worn charcoal utility outfit with muted teal inset panels, a notched stand collar and geometric seams echoing Gh0st’s gear. A small cyan wrist interface links their cinematic designs. Soft fabric, no lab coat, hood or armor. No pale-blue hair, blue eyes, pointed ears or Orion-like facial silhouette. Match this identity in the glass scene and reaching-hand close-up.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Lieutenant Arden Vale
liveProductionIdentities.direction: A mature, controlled officer whose facial structure and silver hair remain recognizable in the current ascended combat form. Use restrained Dominion tailoring before ascension; no youthful fantasy-prince face. Set the shared identity reference before rendering.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Sentinel-3
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Strong blue/cyan single-eye drone silhouette; same identity in dialogue and Sentinel Scraps.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Orlo
liveProductionIdentities.direction: An experienced drill-hand, salt-and-pepper hair and beard, compact work harness; show a worker rather than another heavy-armored commander.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Rourke
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Rourke owns the cook identity: lean face, dark hair/stubble, stained apron, dry expression, one ladle. Remove this face from unrelated characters.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Mira
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Good expressive silhouette and graphic workwear. Keep her goggles, dark hair and orange accents; compare against the first production batch.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Scout Kaelen
liveProductionIdentities.direction: A stranded scout in weathered field gear, practical short hair and sun/wind wear; observant rather than regal. No resemblance to Vale’s uniformed prince placeholder.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Caretaker Echo
liveProductionIdentities.direction: An archive diagnostic unit: hovering geometric body, ivory/stone and muted cyan, a simple scanning aperture. Different chassis from the horticultural Maintenance Bot.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Rylan
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Heat-battered machinist in patched workwear, soot marks and a heat-baffle/tool cue. Base on Rylan’s authored identity, not the cheerful generic mechanic shopkeeper.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Cheno
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Towering broad-shouldered male rigger with an easy grin, work vest and one rigging hook/headset cue. Distinct from Cameron’s leaner, intense pipe-fitting identity.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Chris
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Observant audio engineer/writer, concentrated expression, practical studio layers, one headphone or notebook cue. Do not reuse a cook or give every musician a guitar pose.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Andrew
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Warm, curly-haired musician with a softer expression and one instrument-repair cue; clearly different face, hair mass and palette from Chris.

liveProductionIdentities.name: David
liveProductionIdentities.direction: A mature, warm frontier cook with a broad welcoming face, outdoor layers and a camp apron; one cup or cooking implement. Distinguish from lean mess cook Rourke and fast-moving Ren.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Ren
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Brisk noodle-row chef, tied-back hair or a simple head wrap, rolled sleeves and one ladle; focused energy distinct from David’s hospitality and Rourke’s dry reserve.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Cameron
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Sharp-eyed adult male pipe-fitter in soot-dusted protective coveralls, welding visor pushed back and inherited work gloves; one subtle racing-color accent.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Charles
liveProductionIdentities.direction: An adult analyst in comfortable professional layers, a direct appraising expression and one compact datapad cue. Clearly distinct from Robert and the Curator.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Jason
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Adult builder/musician with an irreverent grin, practical creative-work layers and one synth/cable cue. A recognizable individual, not the shared cook portrait.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Oliver
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Poised black-and-white feline with upright posture and an inspecting gaze; distinct coat pattern and proportions from charcoal Meeko.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Penny
liveProductionIdentities.direction: The current shaggy black-and-white dog is recognizable and friendly. Keep her markings and clear eyes; watch that fur detail does not overpower the finished set.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Megan
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Adult clinical-care specialist with practical hair, clean work layers, teal/white accents and a small inspection tool. Attentive and precise; give her her own face instead of Doc’s.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Evelyn
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Older blonde gardener with visible age, warm laugh lines, expressive brows and practical hydroponic clothing. One pruning/flower cue and a modest jazz-inspired accessory. No goddess halo, closed-eye anime maiden, or young Elara face.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Robert
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Distinguished older entrepreneur with a courtly face, tailored practical jacket and expressive hands. Theatrical warmth without mime face paint or the Curator’s fantasy regalia.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Pam
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep her adult matriarch appearance, practical tied-back brown hair, red work shirt and apron. Render her warmth and firmness in the party’s cel-shaded style; avoid making her a generic young cook.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Meeko
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Heavy charcoal cat-like creature with a broad face and unimpressed gaze. Preserve feline anatomy; no human Orion portrait.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Dax
liveProductionIdentities.direction: A discreet polished bartender with a neat silhouette, dark vest and one bar-towel cue. Clearly not the older field miner Orlo.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Director Sorrell
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Director Sorrell: privileged procurement executive, immaculate suit, expensive lapel detail and disdainful expression. No apron, ladle or Rourke face. Keep the existing internal ID.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Dr. Lyra
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Disgraced chemical specialist with an incisive, tired expression and worn professional coat; a different face/palette from both Doc and Megan.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Selene
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Adult cabaret performer with a composed expressive face, graphic stage jacket and one microphone cue. Distinct silhouette from Evelyn and Elara; avoid exaggerated pin-up styling.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Pitmaster Brutus
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Burly ex-welder/bookmaker with a broad nose, blunt grin, heavy protective apron and an arena tally device. Different body and attitude from hooded Scrapper.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Shopkeep
liveProductionIdentities.direction: The rounded face, moustache, apron and welcoming pose already read well. Preserve the same face in the General Store.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Commander Rylos
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Author a face for the scripted speaker: severe commander with the described chrome facial plating, charcoal work-command uniform and restrained furnace-orange cues. Relate him to the Titan’s machinery without substituting the entire Titan sprite.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Upper City Concierge
liveProductionIdentities.direction: Keep professional poise and dark hair; use clean future-hospitality clothing and simplified face shapes. Avoid the ornate fantasy/anime styling of the current shop portrait.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Arcade Prize Dispenser
liveProductionIdentities.direction: A friendly, graphic prize-terminal faceplate with a ticket/token slot. This is a machine, not the generic mechanic woman currently displayed.

liveProductionIdentities.name: Zenith Automated Commissary
liveProductionIdentities.direction: A sleek corporate dispenser with a simple status display and sealed supply drawer; distinguish it from the Solarium gardener bot and the arcade prize machine.
